$comment: Justified architecture-gate exemptions (#80). Every entry needs rule, path, reason, and owner or ref; ambient-state entries also need match, the exact top-level binding. Scripts/architecture.mjs fails with waiver-contract when an entry is not justified.

waivers.reason: The git adapter is the single process-spawning boundary; no other module implements VcsPort with a child process.
The filesystem adapter is the single node:fs boundary; the store port needs atomic writes, lock files, and raw store reads.
The process-local profile snapshot is the only mutable state the config layer owns; repository config is merged over it on every read.
The configured git timeout is a process-wide default for adapter callers that do not pass one; Tower instances pass their own.
